verdict.rationale: Claude ships official non-interactive programmatic surfaces: the ant CLI and Messages API client SDKs in seven languages. These can drive Claude from scripts. Claude Code also documents lifecycle hooks that run shell commands automatically. However, no evidence documents a dedicated headless or non-interactive mode for Claude Code, and none shows CI integration. Cowork's scheduled tasks are a recurring in-app schedule, not headless or CI execution, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented headless/print mode for Claude Code, CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions) docs, non-interactive auth/output guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Official tools for building with the Claude API: client SDKs in seven languages, the ant CLI, and framework-specific libraries
